title: Chapter 10 — AI Quiz: Data Types & Structures
instructions: Original AI-authored practice, not an official Cambridge or teacher paper. Answer all questions; written responses are self-marked using the guidance after submission. You can retake the quiz.
description: Original chapter practice: multiple-choice and written questions with self-marking guidance.

questions.text: Which data type represents true or false?
Which structure stores multiple values indexed by position?
State one difference between an array and a record.

answer.text: An array contains indexed elements of the same type; a record groups named fields that may have different types.

questions.text: Declare an array of 20 integers called Scores using Cambridge-style pseudocode.
Explain why a record is useful for storing a student’s details.

answer.text: Related fields such as ID and name are grouped together.
Fields can have different data types.

questions.text: Describe the difference between sequential and random file access.

answer.text: Sequential access processes records in sequence.
Random/direct access can locate a record without reading all preceding records.
